key_exclusions: credit issued as Future Flight Credit (FFC) with 1-year expiry, not cash
policy_text_full: United allows changing to a lower fare any time before departure. The fare difference is issued as Future Flight Credit (FFC) valid for 1 year — not a cash refund. Basic Economy fares are excluded from the policy.
policy_text_relevant_clause: Before departure, customers can change to a lower fare; the difference is issued as Future Flight Credit valid 1 year. Basic Economy excluded.
